name: DR Congo
summary: Central African equatorial giant hosting the Congo Basin rainforest, the world's primary tropical carbon sink. Inga rapids on the Congo River provide extraordinary zero-carbon hydroelectric potential.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 7.64x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); extensive domestic charcoal and firewood cooking smoke in Kinshasa and Lubumbashi.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; central equatorial basin maintains relatively low temperature variance.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Equatorial rainforest warming rate across Congo Basin stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.01% share of global fossil emissions; virtually negligible domestic fossil combustion.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Among the lowest per capita fossil emissions in the world; deep off-grid reliance on biomass.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Core of the Congo Basin; holds ~1,530,000 km² of dense tropical rainforest and peatland carbon sinks.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Inga I and Inga II hydroelectric dams on the lower Congo River generate nearly all on-grid electricity.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 45 people/km²; urban population fraction is 46.8%.
